mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST MoM < -5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 0.5% MoM increase and UNRATE < 0.2pp decrease
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a mismatch in inflation and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM increase and FEDFUNDS < -0.25% decrease
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS decreases.
